sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Under this scheme, registered construction workers who have completed skill upgradation training are provided financial assistance of upto ₹15,000/- for purchasing trade-related tools.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Skills & Employment; Sector: Training and Skill Up-gradation

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Grant for Purchase of Tools&quot; scheme is implemented by the Bihar Building &amp; Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB), Labour Resources Department, Government of Bihar. Under this scheme, registered construction workers who have completed skill upgradation training are provided financial assistance of upto ₹15,000/- for purchasing trade-related tools.

**Benefits / Assistance:** Under this scheme, financial assistance of upto ₹15,000/- is provided to registered construction workers for purchasing trade-related tools upon completing skill upgradation training.

**Application Process:** > **Registration of a Construction Worker under BBOCWWB:** **Step 1:** Visit the [Official Website](https://bocwscheme.bihar.gov.in/home) of the Bihar Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. **Step 2:** On the homepage, click on &quot;[Labour Registration](https://bocwscheme.bihar.gov.in/worker_reg)&quot;. **Step 3:** Enter your Aadhar card number and name, then click &quot;Authenticate&quot;. **Step 4:** A dashboard will appear. Enter all required details, ensuring that all fields marked with an asterisk (*) are filled in correctly. **Step 5:** Click on &quot;Submit&quot; and proceed to pay the application fee online. **Step 6:** You will receive your construction worker registration number upon successful registration. > **Apply for Scheme Benefits:** **Step 1:** Visit the [Official Website](https://bocwscheme.bihar.gov.in/home) of the Bihar Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. **Step 2:** Click on &quot;Login&quot; and select &quot;Labour&quot;. **Step 3:** Enter your registration number &amp; year of Birth, click &quot;Show&quot; to view your details. **Step 4:** Select the scheme you wish to apply for to avail the benefits. **Step 5:** Enter all required information and upload the necessary documents. **Step 6:** Click on &quot;Submit Application&quot; to complete the process. > **Application Tracking:** Applicant can track their application status online through the [official website](https://bocwscheme.bihar.gov.in/home) of the Bihar Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. Relevant updates will be sent to the registered mobile number.

**Additional Application Processes:** **Process 2:** Step 1: The interested applicant should visit (during office hours) the concerned Labour Office and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form from the staff exclusively entrusted to issue and collect filled-in applications. Step 2: In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). Step 3: Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to concerned Labour Office.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board; Nodal Department: Labour Resources Department
**Tags:** Tools, Construction Worker, Financial Assistance, Building Worker, Labour, Unorganized Workers
